en: Receptionist
Welcome to the Contest Lobby! ...Oh, you don't have a Pokéblock Case? Every trainer who comes here should. Please, take this one.
It holds the Pokéblocks you blend at the Berry Blender, over there. Your Pokémon will love them!
Welcome to the Contest Lobby! This is the counter for the contests.
Would you like to enter a Pokémon in a contest?
ENTER
INFO
EXIT
We look forward to seeing you and your Pokémon on our stage!
What would you like to know?
THE CONTESTS
THE QUALITIES
THE RANKS
CANCEL
Four Pokémon take the stage. First their condition is judged, and the best goes first. Then there are five rounds of appeals, one move each.
A move earns hearts, startles those who went before, bends the order or stirs the crowd. The hearts count twice over, on top of the condition. Most points wins!
There are five contests, for the five qualities a Pokémon can show: Cool, Beauty, Cute, Smart and Tough. Each move belongs to one of them.
A Pokémon's condition is raised with Pokéblocks, which are blended from berries. The Berry Blender is over there.
There are four ranks: Normal, Super, Hyper and Master. Any Pokémon may enter the Normal Rank.
To go on to a higher rank, a Pokémon must have won the rank under it in the same contest. The winner of a rank wears its ribbon.
Come and see me again whenever you'd like to hear more, or to enter!
Which rank will you enter?
NORMAL RANK
SUPER RANK
HYPER RANK

That Pokémon hasn't won the rank under this one in this contest yet.
Congratulations on your win! The hall confers the {ribbon} on {contestant} as your prize.
{contestant} received the {ribbon}!
{contestant} has won this rank before, so please take this prize from the Contest Hall.
Artist
Your Pokémon spurred me to paint! I couldn't keep my brush still. Here, see what I have made of {contestant}!
Shall I take the painting to the Lilycove Museum, where everyone can see it?
Oh... then you take it home. But I do wish it would hang in the museum, where it belongs.
Wonderful! I'll hang it there myself. Your Pokémon will be famous!
And as a memento of the painting, please take this ribbon for your Pokémon!
{contestant} received the {ribbon}!
Receptionist
This is the counter for contests with friends. Contests with other players are not being held yet. Please try the counter next to me!
Man
Would you like to make Pokéblocks with me at the Berry Blender? Two of us at the drum is just right for a start!
Ah, that's all right. Come back whenever you feel like blending.
Man
We're about to make Pokéblocks. Would you like to blend with the two of us?
Oh, what a pity. Another time, then!
Woman
There's a place for one more at our drum! Would you like to make Pokéblocks with the three of us?
Oh dear. Do come back if you change your mind!
You'll need a Pokéblock Case to keep what we make. The receptionist at the counter will give you one.
Excellent! Choose a berry to blend. The more your berry's flavour stands out from the others', the better the Pokéblock.
That's a fine Pokéblock! It's in your Case. Your Pokémon will love it.
Your Pokéblock Case is full. Feed some Pokéblocks to your Pokémon, or throw a few away, and come back.
Old Man
Well, well. A young blender! The secret of a great Pokéblock is rhythm. Press as the arm comes round, and never a beat early!
Shall we blend a Pokéblock together?
Another time, then. The arm waits for no one, but I do.
Let's get blending already! The leader of our drum is waiting for a partner.
A portrait of {wallmon}, a winner here. Its trainer is {wall}.
An empty frame. No winner has been hung here yet.
